subject: Woven's data curation solution
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Woven by Toyota, among hundreds of other global computer vision teams, so thought it'd make sense to reach out to see if we can help you and the team in a similar way.

Woven's Computer Vision team faced challenges with data curation (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets (capping out at ~1m images).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Open to learning more?

Our Founder/President [SENDER] Stig [SENDER] will be hosting an intimate roundtable dinner with customers & AI leaders and we'd love for you to join if you're available.

We've booked a private dining room at Taverna in Palo Alto on Wednesday February 26th starting at 6:30pm, capping attendance to ~20 people. Join us to meet & share perspectives with fellow AI leaders on key trends heading into [YEAR].

Previous attendees include Co-Founders, CEO's, CTOs & Heads of ML etc. from leading VC-backed scale-ups such as Waymo, Synthesia, and Airbnb as well as larger orgs such as Baker Hughes, Philips & Nvidia. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're an SF-based data development platform (recently raised our Series B) built to help Multimodal AI teams get better models to market, faster. 

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.

subject: Woven's data curation solution
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Woven by Toyota, among hundreds of other global computer vision teams, so thought it'd make sense to reach out to see if we can help you and the team in a similar way.

Woven's Computer Vision team faced challenges with data curation (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets (capping out at ~1m images).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Open to learning more?
